per_query.prompt: roguelike deckbuilder where each run I build a new deck

before.title: Slay the Spire
before.reason: This is the definitive roguelike deckbuilder where you start with a basic set of cards and draft new ones after every encounter to create powerful synergies. Every run requires adapting your strategy to the specific cards and relics you find along the way.

before.title: Balatro
before.reason: A unique poker-themed roguelike where you build a deck of Jokers and modified playing cards to create massive scoring combos. It perfectly captures the loop of starting fresh and constructing a broken, high-scoring engine each run.

before.title: Loop Hero
before.reason: While it features auto-battler elements, you manage a deck of landscape cards to build the world around your hero. Each run involves choosing which cards to bring and strategically placing them to manage difficulty and rewards.

after.title: Slay the Spire
after.reason: Every card choice you make ripples through your run as you climb the spire. You will build a new deck of abilities each time to overcome this deceptively deep and challenging experience.

after.title: Balatro
after.reason: You will stack joker synergies and manipulate poker hands to create absurd scoring combos. It provides a compelling way to build a new deck of powerful cards during every attempt.

after.title: Loop Hero
after.reason: You use a deck of cards to place tiles and reconstruct a world for a looping hero. It lets you build a new deck of locations to survive each hypnotic run through the loop.

before.title: Super Meat Boy
before.reason: This game is the definition of brutally hard, featuring instant death and pixel-perfect platforming that makes every successful level feel like a massive victory.

before.title: Celeste
before.reason: While the mountain climb is incredibly difficult and requires extreme precision, the tight controls and fair mechanics ensure that overcoming its toughest challenges is deeply satisfying.

before.reason: The game features punishing boss encounters and tight combat that demand mastery, rewarding your persistence with a sense of accomplishment and further exploration of its beautiful world.
